name: Petal OS
author: Marinara Engine
description: A pastel pixel desktop: every message, dialog and Home widget is a crisp little window with a title bar and _ [] X buttons, on a soft pixel city. Morning pink by day, plum CRT glow by night (suggests Follow time of day). Pixel fonts throughout: if they are hard to read, set Font back to Inter.
